authority_context_note: SRC069 is path-context-sensitive. Serving src/03_sources/SRC069/original/original.html or split/index.html directly from their repository paths is NOT runtime-equivalent to the authority: the authority's own ../../ portal paths resolve only from the canonical selected-D directory depth. authority-context.json records that depth and all 11 sibling portal target identities as metadata only. The ~35.7 MB target corpus is NOT vendored into this capsule, and no relative URL is rewritten.

capture_surface.note: Neither src/03_sources/SRC069/original/original.html nor split/index.html is a valid standalone runtime surface at its repository path. The authority's own ../../ portal URLs resolve only from the canonical selected-D directory depth recorded in authority-context.json. The shared single-executable baseline and parity harnesses therefore fail closed with an explicit CONTEXT_AWARE_SURFACE_ONLY SKIP for this capsule instead of producing a green-but-wrong artifact or attempting a parity promotion the Source cannot support. This flag is a manifest-maintained opt-in: SINGLE Sources that do not declare capture_surface keep the existing generic capture behavior.

portal_context_contract.s4_requirement_note: S4 parity requires context-aware serving of BOTH original and split at the canonical selected-D virtual depth. It is NOT executable by loading the repository split path directly.
